intent.title: cache prices in checkout
intent.body:
Prices almost never change, so checkout now keeps its own price list and does not call the pricing service on every order anymore.

- removes one network call per order
- pricing service stays up for other users, checkout just does not depend on it

Expected after deploy: no more calls from checkout to pricing.

files.patch:
@@ -9,9 +9,11 @@
 logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s")
 log = logging.getLogger("checkout")
 
-PRICING_URL = os.environ.get("PRICING_URL", "http://pricing:8080")
 PAYMENTS_URL = os.environ.get("PAYMENTS_URL", "http://payments:8080")
 
+# prices barely change, so checkout keeps its own copy and skips the pricing call
+PRICES = {"tea": 4.50, "coffee": 6.00, "cake": 8.25, "cookie": 2.75}
+
 app = FastAPI()
 client = httpx.Client(timeout=2.0)
 
@@ -28,11 +30,10 @@ def healthz():
 
 @app.post("/checkout")
 def checkout(order: Order):
-    r = client.get(f"{PRICING_URL}/price", params={"item": order.item})
-    if r.status_code != 200:
-        log.warning("price lookup failed item=%s status=%s", order.item, r.status_code)
-        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="pricing unavailable")
-    total = round(r.json()["price"] * order.qty, 2)
+    if order.item not in PRICES:
+        log.warning("unknown item=%s", order.item)
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="unknown item")
+    total = round(PRICES[order.item] * order.qty, 2)
 
     p = client.post(f"{PAYMENTS_URL}/charge", json={"amount": total})
     if p.status_code != 200:
